head: 8467f01
summary: PY geometry and materials are frozen. All eight studio views p1-p8 are pixel-identical to 1430d42 (0 changed px), and 09b_py.js and the PY SEATMAT keys are untouched; only 04_shaders.js, 12_scene.js and 07_shell.js changed. The lighting final touch fixes the cool cast I had routed as a medium. q14 mid-back fabric goes from B/R 1.390 to 1.297 (B-R 43.6 -> 33.9) and q13 front-back fabric from 1.492 to 1.379, with L unchanged (124.5 -> 124.4 and 109.2 -> 109.0). That puts q14 on the 1.30 target and both views inside the photos' 1.22-1.36 band (q13 is 0.02 above it). The shell and console warm by the same amount (q14 shell 1.365 -> 1.286, q13 console 1.421 -> 1.319). Diffing old against head shows no new PY artefacts. In the seat zone (y >= 190) no pixel changes by more than 8 L except 116 px at the window-reveal top edge (x 547-607, y 190-195). The maximum column-mean dL is 0.74 and the maximum row-mean is 1.08, so there are no stripes. The L<25 dark-pixel count changes by under 2 % (8949 -> 8995). Seam-bead minima are identical within 1 L. The change is a uniform mean dRGB of (+1.5, +0.1, -4.8), a pure white-balance shift. Still open: the cushion-front band (medium, PY's own, frozen) and the low sun patch, which is unchanged. The score stays at 8.5, the pass line: the colour items now pass, and the remaining gap is the carried-over cushion crease and the low-level fabric and pocket items.
lighting_note: Not scored. (1) The cool-cast hand-off is done: q14 fabric B/R 1.297 and q13 1.379, against the photos' 1.22-1.36. If anything, q13 could lose another ~0.03, but that is not required. (2) The diamond sun patch on the q14 window-seat back (x 485-550, y 300-420) is unchanged: L 178.7 at both heads, sd 50.8, against a mid-back L of 124. py_37301 and py_37303 show evenly lit seat backs, so it is still a low lighting item. (3) The q14 window reveals above y 182 brighten by about +17 L (2,854 px > 15 L, bbox x 283-929, y 53-182), which is the 07_shell / window-wall change and does not touch the seats. The q14 sidewall below the window also warms slightly (B-R 12.9 -> 10.8). (4) The seam bead in the shaded bottom of q14 is still L 19-32 (crevice AO), the same as before.

before_vs_after.verdict: Head 8467f01 is equal to or better than 1430d42 for PY. The lighting final touch takes the fabric back to the photos' blue-grey (q14 B/R 1.39 -> 1.30) without changing luminance or contrast, and adds no stripes, seams or dark artefacts on the seats. PY passes at 8.5 with no high issue. Its only medium is the long-standing cushion-front crease.
